items.question: Trong câu "The job is less "draw the boxes" and more "decide which boxes, and be able to defend why".", từ "defend" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The job is less "draw the boxes" and more "decide which boxes, and be able to defend why".", what does "defend" (verb) mean?
options: biện minh, bảo vệ lập luận
items.explanation: defend /dɪˈfend/ (động từ): biện minh, bảo vệ lập luận. "Defend a decision" = đưa ra lý do để bảo vệ một quyết định trước người khác.
items.explanationEn: defend /dɪˈfend/ (verb): to justify with reasons. "Defend a decision" means giving reasons that support it when others question it.

items.question: Trong câu "Discovery — finding the real problem, goals, constraints and what success looks like in numbers.", từ "constraint" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Discovery — finding the real problem, goals, constraints and what success looks like in numbers.", what does "constraint" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (danh từ): ràng buộc, giới hạn. Trong kiến trúc, "constraints" là những giới hạn cố định như ngân sách, công nghệ hay luật.
items.explanationEn: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (noun): a limit or restriction. In architecture, constraints are fixed limits such as budget, technology or regulation.

items.question: Trong câu "Documentation — diagrams and decision records that outlive the meeting.", từ "outlive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Documentation — diagrams and decision records that outlive the meeting.", what does "outlive" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: outlive /ˌaʊtˈlɪv/ (động từ): tồn tại lâu hơn. "Outlive X" = còn tồn tại sau khi X đã kết thúc; tài liệu vẫn còn giá trị sau cuộc họp.
items.explanationEn: outlive /ˌaʊtˈlɪv/ (verb): to last longer than. "Outlive X" means continuing to exist after X is over; the documents stay useful after the meeting.

items.question: Trong câu "Governance — checking that what gets built still matches the design, and changing the design when reality disagrees.", từ "governance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Governance — checking that what gets built still matches the design, and changing the design when reality disagrees.", what does "governance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: governance /ˈɡʌv.ən.əns/ (danh từ): sự giám sát, quản trị. Trong CNTT, "governance" là việc giám sát để hệ thống được xây đúng quy tắc và thiết kế.
items.explanationEn: governance /ˈɡʌv.ən.əns/ (noun): oversight and control. In IT, governance means overseeing work so systems follow agreed rules and designs.

items.question: Trong câu "an SA is accountable for one solution (a product, a migration, an integration) end to end", từ "accountable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "an SA is accountable for one solution (a product, a migration, an integration) end to end", what does "accountable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: accountable /əˈkaʊn.tə.bəl/ (tính từ): chịu trách nhiệm. "Be accountable for X" = chịu trách nhiệm (và phải giải trình) về X.
items.explanationEn: accountable /əˈkaʊn.tə.bəl/ (adjective): responsible for. "Be accountable for X" means being responsible for X and answering for its results.

items.question: Trong câu "usually spanning several systems and teams", từ "span" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "usually spanning several systems and teams", what does "span" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: span /spæn/ (động từ): trải rộng qua. "Span several systems" = trải qua, bao trùm nhiều hệ thống cùng lúc.
items.explanationEn: span /spæn/ (verb): to extend across. "Span several systems" means covering or reaching across many systems at once.

items.question: Trong câu "pre-sales or partner architects who design on the customer's behalf", từ "behalf" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "pre-sales or partner architects who design on the customer's behalf", what does "behalf" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: behalf /bɪˈhɑːf/ (danh từ): thay mặt, đại diện. "On someone's behalf" / "on behalf of someone" = thay mặt ai đó làm việc gì.
items.explanationEn: behalf /bɪˈhɑːf/ (noun): as a representative of. "On someone's behalf" or "on behalf of someone" means acting for or representing them.

items.question: Trong câu "so in interviews be ready to say which flavour you mean", từ "flavour" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "so in interviews be ready to say which flavour you mean", what does "flavour" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: flavour /ˈfleɪ.vər/ (danh từ): loại, biến thể. Nghĩa bóng: "flavour" (Mỹ: flavor) = một kiểu/biến thể của cùng một thứ, ví dụ "Linux flavours".
items.explanationEn: flavour /ˈfleɪ.vər/ (noun): a kind or variant. Figuratively, flavour (US: flavor) means one variety of the same thing, e.g. "Linux flavours".

items.question: Trong câu "Titles overlap and every company uses them differently", từ "overlap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Titles overlap and every company uses them differently", what does "overlap" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to partly cover the same area
items.explanation: overlap /ˌəʊ.vəˈlæp/ (động từ): chồng lấn một phần. Các chức danh "overlap" nghĩa là phạm vi công việc trùng nhau một phần.
items.explanationEn: overlap /ˌəʊ.vəˈlæp/ (verb): to partly cover the same area. When titles overlap, the work they describe is partly shared.

items.question: Trong câu "but the useful distinction is scope — how wide the view is and how deep into the code it goes.", từ "distinction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "but the useful distinction is scope — how wide the view is and how deep into the code it goes.", what does "distinction" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: distinction /dɪˈstɪŋk.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự phân biệt, khác biệt. "Draw a distinction between A and B" = phân biệt A với B.
items.explanationEn: distinction /dɪˈstɪŋk.ʃən/ (noun): a difference between things. "Draw a distinction between A and B" means pointing out how A and B differ.

items.question: Trong câu "An SA takes standards from the enterprise architect and guardrails from the cloud architect", từ "guardrail" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An SA takes standards from the enterprise architect and guardrails from the cloud architect", what does "guardrail" (noun) mean?
options: quy tắc an toàn bắt buộc
items.explanation: guardrail /ˈɡɑːd.reɪl/ (danh từ): quy tắc an toàn bắt buộc. Nghĩa gốc là lan can bảo vệ; trong cloud, "guardrails" là các quy tắc ngăn cấu hình nguy hiểm.
items.explanationEn: guardrail /ˈɡɑːd.reɪl/ (noun): a mandatory safety rule. Literally a protective rail; in the cloud, guardrails are rules that block unsafe configurations.

items.question: Trong câu "In small companies one person wears all four hats.", từ "hat" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In small companies one person wears all four hats.", what does "hat" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: hat /hæt/ (danh từ): vai trò, nhiệm vụ. Thành ngữ "wear many hats" = một người đảm nhận nhiều vai trò khác nhau.
items.explanationEn: hat /hæt/ (noun): a role or duty. The idiom "wear many hats" means one person holds several different roles.

items.question: Trong câu "They describe behaviour and are usually captured as user stories or use cases.", từ "capture" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They describe behaviour and are usually captured as user stories or use cases.", what does "capture" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: capture /ˈkæp.tʃər/ (động từ): ghi lại, thể hiện. "Capture requirements" = ghi lại, mô tả yêu cầu dưới một hình thức cụ thể.
items.explanationEn: capture /ˈkæp.tʃər/ (verb): to record or express. "Capture requirements" means recording them in a concrete form.

items.question: Trong câu "Constraints — decisions already made for you, not negotiable in this project", từ "negotiable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Constraints — decisions already made for you, not negotiable in this project", what does "negotiable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: negotiable /nɪˈɡəʊ.ʃi.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): có thể thương lượng. "Not negotiable" = không thể bàn lại, bắt buộc phải tuân theo.
items.explanationEn: negotiable /nɪˈɡəʊ.ʃi.ə.bəl/ (adjective): open to discussion. "Not negotiable" means it cannot be changed through discussion.

items.question: Trong câu "Assumptions — things you believe but have not verified", từ "verify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Assumptions — things you believe but have not verified", what does "verify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: verify /ˈver.ɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): kiểm chứng. "Verify an assumption" = kiểm tra để chắc chắn giả định là đúng.
items.explanationEn: verify /ˈver.ɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to confirm is true. "Verify an assumption" means checking that it is actually true.

items.question: Trong câu "Write them down; a wrong assumption is a risk.", từ "assumption" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Write them down; a wrong assumption is a risk.", what does "assumption" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: assumption /əˈsʌmp.ʃən/ (danh từ): giả định. "Make an assumption" = đưa ra giả định; giả định chưa kiểm chứng nên được ghi lại như rủi ro.
items.explanationEn: assumption /əˈsʌmp.ʃən/ (noun): a belief taken as true. "Make an assumption" means taking something as true without proof; record them as risks.

items.question: Trong câu "the system works in the demo and falls over in production", từ "fall over" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the system works in the demo and falls over in production", what does "fall over" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: fall over /fɔːl ˈəʊ.vər/ (cụm từ): sập, ngừng hoạt động. Tiếng Anh thân mật (Anh-Anh): hệ thống "falls over" = bị sập.
items.explanationEn: fall over /fɔːl ˈəʊ.vər/ (phrase): to crash or stop working. Informal (mainly British): a system that falls over has crashed.

items.question: Trong câu "treating a constraint as a requirement you can trade away", từ "trade away" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "treating a constraint as a requirement you can trade away", what does "trade away" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: trade away /treɪd əˈweɪ/ (cụm từ): đánh đổi, từ bỏ. "Trade away X" = chấp nhận bỏ X để đổi lấy lợi ích khác.
items.explanationEn: trade away /treɪd əˈweɪ/ (phrase): to give up in exchange. "Trade away X" means giving X up to gain something else.

items.question: Trong câu "it is the NFRs — scale, availability, latency, security, compliance — that force distribution, caching, replication and cost.", từ "compliance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "it is the NFRs — scale, availability, latency, security, compliance — that force distribution, caching, replication and cost.", what does "compliance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: compliance /kəmˈplaɪ.əns/ (danh từ): sự tuân thủ quy định. "Compliance" = tuân thủ luật, tiêu chuẩn (GDPR, PCI DSS...). Tính từ: compliant.
items.explanationEn: compliance /kəmˈplaɪ.əns/ (noun): following rules and laws. Compliance means meeting laws and standards (GDPR, PCI DSS...). Adjective: compliant.

items.question: Trong câu "ISO/IEC 25010 is the standard catalogue", từ "catalogue" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "ISO/IEC 25010 is the standard catalogue", what does "catalogue" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: catalogue /ˈkæt.əl.ɒɡ/ (danh từ): danh mục có hệ thống. "Catalogue" (Mỹ: catalog) = danh sách được sắp xếp có hệ thống.
items.explanationEn: catalogue /ˈkæt.əl.ɒɡ/ (noun): a systematic list. A catalogue (US: catalog) is an organised, complete list of items.

items.question: Trong câu "the six pillars of AWS Well-Architected are a cloud-flavoured version", từ "pillar" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the six pillars of AWS Well-Architected are a cloud-flavoured version", what does "pillar" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pillar /ˈpɪl.ər/ (danh từ): nguyên tắc trụ cột. Nghĩa bóng: "pillar" = yếu tố nền tảng quan trọng nhất của một hệ thống ý tưởng.
items.explanationEn: pillar /ˈpɪl.ər/ (noun): a core principle. Figuratively, a pillar is one of the key principles something rests on.

items.question: Trong câu "Also translate availability targets into downtime, because stakeholders feel minutes, not nines", từ "stakeholder" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Also translate availability targets into downtime, because stakeholders feel minutes, not nines", what does "stakeholder" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: stakeholder /ˈsteɪkˌhəʊl.dər/ (danh từ): bên liên quan. "Stakeholders" = mọi người bị ảnh hưởng hoặc quan tâm đến dự án (khách hàng, lãnh đạo, dev...).
items.explanationEn: stakeholder /ˈsteɪkˌhəʊl.dər/ (noun): a person with an interest. Stakeholders are all people affected by or interested in a project.

items.question: Trong câu "Also translate availability targets into downtime", từ "downtime" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Also translate availability targets into downtime", what does "downtime" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: downtime /ˈdaʊn.taɪm/ (danh từ): thời gian ngừng hoạt động. "Downtime" trong CNTT = khoảng thời gian hệ thống không dùng được; ngược lại là "uptime".
items.explanationEn: downtime /ˈdaʊn.taɪm/ (noun): time a system is unavailable. In IT, downtime is the time a system cannot be used; the opposite is uptime.

items.question: Trong câu "Each extra nine usually means roughly another step up in cost and complexity", từ "roughly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each extra nine usually means roughly another step up in cost and complexity", what does "roughly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: roughly /ˈrʌf.li/ (trạng từ): xấp xỉ, khoảng. "Roughly" = khoảng chừng; hay đi với con số: "roughly 10 ms".
items.explanationEn: roughly /ˈrʌf.li/ (adverb): approximately. "Roughly" means approximately and often comes before numbers: "roughly 10 ms".

items.question: Trong câu "then automated failover with no human in the loop", từ "in the loop" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "then automated failover with no human in the loop", what does "in the loop" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in the loop /ɪn ðə luːp/ (cụm từ): tham gia vào quy trình. "Human in the loop" = có con người tham gia ra quyết định; "keep someone in the loop" = cập nhật cho ai.
items.explanationEn: in the loop /ɪn ðə luːp/ (phrase): involved in the process. "Human in the loop" means a person takes part in decisions; "keep someone in the loop" means keep them informed.

items.question: Trong câu "If you think you found an option with no downside, you have not found the downside yet.", từ "downside" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you think you found an option with no downside, you have not found the downside yet.", what does "downside" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: downside /ˈdaʊn.saɪd/ (danh từ): mặt trái, nhược điểm. "Downside" = điểm bất lợi; trái nghĩa là "upside" (điểm lợi).
items.explanationEn: downside /ˈdaʊn.saɪd/ (noun): a disadvantage. A downside is a disadvantage; the opposite is an upside.

items.question: Trong câu "An architect's value is naming the trade-off explicitly, not pretending it away.", từ "explicitly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An architect's value is naming the trade-off explicitly, not pretending it away.", what does "explicitly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt.li/ (trạng từ): rõ ràng, minh bạch. "State explicitly" = nói rõ ràng; trái nghĩa là "implicitly" (ngầm).
items.explanationEn: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt.li/ (adverb): clearly and openly. "State explicitly" means saying it clearly; the opposite is implicitly.

items.question: Trong câu "Compare at least two real options (plus "do nothing") against weighted criteria taken from the NFRs", từ "weighted" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Compare at least two real options (plus "do nothing") against weighted criteria taken from the NFRs", what does "weighted" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: weighted /ˈweɪ.tɪd/ (tính từ): có trọng số. "Weighted criteria" = tiêu chí được gán trọng số theo mức độ quan trọng.
items.explanationEn: weighted /ˈweɪ.tɪd/ (adjective): given relative importance. "Weighted criteria" are criteria given scores by how much they matter.

items.question: Trong câu "not against personal taste", từ "taste" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "not against personal taste", what does "taste" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: taste /teɪst/ (danh từ): sở thích, gu. "Personal taste" = sở thích cá nhân, không dựa trên số liệu.
items.explanationEn: taste /teɪst/ (noun): personal preference. "Personal taste" means individual preference rather than evidence.

items.question: Trong câu "Reversible decisions (a logging library, an instance size) should be made fast.", từ "reversible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reversible decisions (a logging library, an instance size) should be made fast.", what does "reversible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: reversible /rɪˈvɜː.sə.bəl/ (tính từ): có thể đảo ngược. "Reversible decision" = quyết định có thể quay lại; trái nghĩa: irreversible.
items.explanationEn: reversible /rɪˈvɜː.sə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be undone. A reversible decision can be undone; the opposite is irreversible.

items.question: Trong câu "deserve prototypes and review", từ "deserve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "deserve prototypes and review", what does "deserve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: deserve /dɪˈzɜːv/ (động từ): xứng đáng được. "Deserve X" = đáng được X; ở đây quyết định khó đảo ngược đáng được làm thử và review.
items.explanationEn: deserve /dɪˈzɜːv/ (verb): to merit. "Deserve X" means being worthy of X; hard-to-reverse decisions merit prototypes and review.

items.question: Trong câu "replication factor affects durability, write latency and cost at once", từ "at once" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "replication factor affects durability, write latency and cost at once", what does "at once" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at once /ət wʌns/ (cụm từ): cùng một lúc. "At once" có hai nghĩa: "cùng lúc" (như ở đây) và "ngay lập tức".
items.explanationEn: at once /ət wʌns/ (phrase): at the same time. "At once" has two senses: "simultaneously" (as here) and "immediately".

items.question: Trong câu "Architecture is a loop, not a phase that ends when coding starts.", từ "phase" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Architecture is a loop, not a phase that ends when coding starts.", what does "phase" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: phase /feɪz/ (danh từ): giai đoạn. "Project phase" = giai đoạn dự án; "phase out" = loại bỏ dần.
items.explanationEn: phase /feɪz/ (noun): a stage in a process. A project phase is a stage of work; "phase out" means remove gradually.

items.question: Trong câu "time-box spikes for the riskiest unknowns (a vendor API's rate limits, a database at your write volume) instead of debating them.", từ "time-box" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "time-box spikes for the riskiest unknowns (a vendor API's rate limits, a database at your write volume) instead of debating them.", what does "time-box" (verb) mean?
options: giới hạn thời gian cố định
optionsEn: to set a fixed time limit
items.explanation: time-box /ˈtaɪm.bɒks/ (động từ): giới hạn thời gian cố định. "Time-box a task" = đặt trước một khoảng thời gian cố định để làm, hết giờ thì dừng.
items.explanationEn: time-box /ˈtaɪm.bɒks/ (verb): to set a fixed time limit. "Time-box a task" means giving it a fixed amount of time and stopping when time is up.

items.question: Trong câu "time-box spikes for the riskiest unknowns", từ "spike" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "time-box spikes for the riskiest unknowns", what does "spike" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: spike /spaɪk/ (danh từ): thử nghiệm kỹ thuật ngắn. Trong Agile, "spike" = thử nghiệm ngắn để giảm điều chưa biết; còn "traffic spike" = lưu lượng tăng vọt.
items.explanationEn: spike /spaɪk/ (noun): a short technical experiment. In Agile, a spike is a short experiment to reduce unknowns; a "traffic spike" is a sudden surge.

items.question: Trong câu "an architect who vanishes after the design doc produces "ivory tower" designs the team quietly ignores.", từ "vanish" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "an architect who vanishes after the design doc produces "ivory tower" designs the team quietly ignores.", what does "vanish" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: vanish /ˈvæn.ɪʃ/ (động từ): biến mất. "Vanish" = biến mất đột ngột; kiến trúc sư biến mất sau khi viết tài liệu thiết kế.
items.explanationEn: vanish /ˈvæn.ɪʃ/ (verb): to disappear. "Vanish" means disappear suddenly; here the architect is no longer seen after the design doc.

items.question: Trong câu "stop the architecture eroding", từ "erode" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "stop the architecture eroding", what does "erode" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to be worn away by water
items.explanation: erode /ɪˈrəʊd/ (động từ): xuống cấp dần. Nghĩa gốc là xói mòn; nghĩa bóng: chất lượng kiến trúc giảm dần theo thời gian.
items.explanationEn: erode /ɪˈrəʊd/ (verb): to weaken gradually. Literally worn away by nature; figuratively, architecture quality slowly declining over time.

items.question: Trong câu "migration and rollback plan", từ "rollback" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "migration and rollback plan", what does "rollback" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a return to an earlier version
items.explanation: rollback /ˈrəʊl.bæk/ (danh từ): sự quay lui phiên bản. "Rollback plan" = kế hoạch quay về phiên bản cũ nếu triển khai lỗi. Động từ: roll back.
items.explanationEn: rollback /ˈrəʊl.bæk/ (noun): a return to an earlier version. A rollback plan explains how to return to the previous version if a release fails. Verb: roll back.

items.question: Trong câu "An Architecture Decision Record is a short document capturing one architecturally significant decision, its context and its consequences.", từ "significant" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An Architecture Decision Record is a short document capturing one architecturally significant decision, its context and its consequences.", what does "significant" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: significant /sɪɡˈnɪf.ɪ.kənt/ (tính từ): quan trọng, có ảnh hưởng. "Architecturally significant" = đủ quan trọng để ảnh hưởng tới kiến trúc.
items.explanationEn: significant /sɪɡˈnɪf.ɪ.kənt/ (adjective): important and influential. "Architecturally significant" means important enough to affect the architecture.

items.question: Trong câu "The widely used lightweight format comes from Michael Nygard (2011).", từ "lightweight" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The widely used lightweight format comes from Michael Nygard (2011).", what does "lightweight" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: lightweight /ˈlaɪt.weɪt/ (tính từ): đơn giản, gọn nhẹ. "Lightweight process/format" = đơn giản, ít thủ tục; cũng có nghĩa bóng là "không quan trọng" (về người).
items.explanationEn: lightweight /ˈlaɪt.weɪt/ (adjective): simple and minimal. A lightweight process or format is simple with little overhead; of a person it can mean unimportant.

items.question: Trong câu "Status lifecycle: proposed → accepted → deprecated or superseded.", từ "deprecated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Status lifecycle: proposed → accepted → deprecated or superseded.", what does "deprecated" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: deprecated /ˈdep.rə.keɪ.tɪd/ (tính từ): không còn khuyến nghị dùng. "Deprecated" = vẫn tồn tại nhưng không nên dùng nữa; khác "removed" (đã bị xóa).
items.explanationEn: deprecated /ˈdep.rə.keɪ.tɪd/ (adjective): no longer recommended. Deprecated means it still exists but should no longer be used; unlike removed.

items.question: Trong câu "Accepted ADRs are immutable: when the decision changes, write a new ADR that supersedes the old one and link both ways", từ "immutable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Accepted ADRs are immutable: when the decision changes, write a new ADR that supersedes the old one and link both ways", what does "immutable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: immutable /ɪˈmjuː.tə.bəl/ (tính từ): không thể thay đổi. "Immutable" = bất biến; trái nghĩa "mutable". Hay gặp: immutable data, immutable infrastructure.
items.explanationEn: immutable /ɪˈmjuː.tə.bəl/ (adjective): unable to be changed. Immutable means unchangeable; the opposite is mutable. Common: immutable data, immutable infrastructure.

items.question: Trong câu "write a new ADR that supersedes the old one and link both ways", từ "supersede" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "write a new ADR that supersedes the old one and link both ways", what does "supersede" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: supersede /ˌsuː.pəˈsiːd/ (động từ): thay thế (cái cũ). "A supersedes B" = A thay thế B, B không còn hiệu lực. Chú ý viết với "s": supersede.
items.explanationEn: supersede /ˌsuː.pəˈsiːd/ (verb): to take the place of. "A supersedes B" means A replaces B, which is no longer in force. Note the spelling with "s".

items.question: Trong câu "Consequences include the negatives — what we gave up, which risks we accepted.", từ "give up" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Consequences include the negatives — what we gave up, which risks we accepted.", what does "give up" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: give up /ɡɪv ʌp/ (cụm từ): hi sinh, từ bỏ. "Give up X" = chấp nhận mất X (để đổi lấy thứ khác); cũng có nghĩa "bỏ cuộc".
items.explanationEn: give up /ɡɪv ʌp/ (phrase): to sacrifice. "Give up X" means sacrificing X for something else; it can also mean to quit trying.

items.question: Trong câu "It predates Docker and does not mean a Docker container.", từ "predate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It predates Docker and does not mean a Docker container.", what does "predate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: predate /ˌpriːˈdeɪt/ (động từ): có trước (về thời gian). "A predates B" = A xuất hiện trước B; trái nghĩa "postdate".
items.explanationEn: predate /ˌpriːˈdeɪt/ (verb): to exist earlier than. "A predates B" means A existed before B; the opposite is postdate.

items.question: Trong câu "Draw it only for containers that are complex or contested; it goes stale fast.", từ "contested" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Draw it only for containers that are complex or contested; it goes stale fast.", what does "contested" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: contested /kənˈtes.tɪd/ (tính từ): gây tranh cãi. "A contested design" = thiết kế đang bị tranh luận, chưa thống nhất.
items.explanationEn: contested /kənˈtes.tɪd/ (adjective): disputed. A contested design is one people disagree about.

items.question: Trong câu "Draw it only for containers that are complex or contested; it goes stale fast.", từ "stale" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Draw it only for containers that are complex or contested; it goes stale fast.", what does "stale" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: stale /steɪl/ (tính từ): lỗi thời, không cập nhật. "Go stale" = trở nên lỗi thời; "stale cache/data" = dữ liệu cũ không còn đúng.
items.explanationEn: stale /steɪl/ (adjective): out of date. "Go stale" means become out of date; "stale data" is old data that may be wrong.

items.question: Trong câu "One level of abstraction per diagram — do not mix classes and external systems in the same picture.", từ "abstraction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One level of abstraction per diagram — do not mix classes and external systems in the same picture.", what does "abstraction" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: abstraction /æbˈstræk.ʃən/ (danh từ): mức độ trừu tượng. "Level of abstraction" = mức độ chi tiết/khái quát khi mô tả hệ thống.
items.explanationEn: abstraction /æbˈstræk.ʃən/ (noun): a level of generalisation. "Level of abstraction" means how general or detailed a description of a system is.

items.question: Trong câu "Every arrow is one-directional and labelled with intent and, at level 2+, protocol", từ "intent" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every arrow is one-directional and labelled with intent and, at level 2+, protocol", what does "intent" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: intent /ɪnˈtent/ (danh từ): mục đích, ý định. "Intent" = mục đích; mũi tên nên ghi rõ mục đích như "publishes OrderPlaced".
items.explanationEn: intent /ɪnˈtent/ (noun): purpose or aim. Intent means purpose; each arrow should state what it is for, like "publishes OrderPlaced".

items.question: Trong câu "Notation rules that make any diagram readable:", từ "notation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Notation rules that make any diagram readable:", what does "notation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: notation /nəʊˈteɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): hệ ký hiệu. "Notation" = hệ thống ký hiệu quy ước, như Big O notation hay UML notation.
items.explanationEn: notation /nəʊˈteɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a system of symbols. Notation is an agreed system of symbols, as in Big O notation or UML notation.

items.question: Trong câu "A correct design that nobody buys into does not get built.", từ "buy into" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A correct design that nobody buys into does not get built.", what does "buy into" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: buy into /baɪ ˈɪn.tuː/ (cụm từ): tin tưởng và ủng hộ. "Buy into an idea" = đồng tình và ủng hộ; "buy-in" (n) = sự ủng hộ.
items.explanationEn: buy into /baɪ ˈɪn.tuː/ (phrase): to believe in and support. "Buy into an idea" means accepting and supporting it; "buy-in" is the noun.

items.question: Trong câu "Map stakeholders by their concerns and speak to those concerns", từ "concern" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Map stakeholders by their concerns and speak to those concerns", what does "concern" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: concern /kənˈsɜːn/ (danh từ): mối quan tâm. "Concern" có nhiều nghĩa; ở đây là điều mà mỗi bên quan tâm. "Speak to a concern" = trả lời đúng mối quan tâm đó.
items.explanationEn: concern /kənˈsɜːn/ (noun): a matter of interest. Concern has several senses; here it is what each party cares about. "Speak to a concern" means address it.

items.question: Trong câu "Bottom line up front. Start with the recommendation and its cost/risk; details follow for those who want them.", từ "bottom line" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Bottom line up front. Start with the recommendation and its cost/risk; details follow for those who want them.", what does "bottom line" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: the last line on a page
items.explanation: bottom line /ˌbɒt.əm ˈlaɪn/ (cụm từ): điểm mấu chốt, kết luận. "Bottom line up front" (BLUF) = nói kết luận trước; nghĩa kế toán là lợi nhuận ròng.
items.explanationEn: bottom line /ˌbɒt.əm ˈlaɪn/ (phrase): the key conclusion. "Bottom line up front" (BLUF) means stating the conclusion first; in accounting it means net profit.

items.question: Trong câu "Two or three options with trade-offs and a recommendation earn trust", từ "earn" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two or three options with trade-offs and a recommendation earn trust", what does "earn" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: earn /ɜːn/ (động từ): giành được (nhờ xứng đáng). "Earn trust/respect" = giành được lòng tin nhờ hành động xứng đáng.
items.explanationEn: earn /ɜːn/ (verb): to gain by merit. "Earn trust or respect" means gaining it through deserving behaviour.

items.question: Trong câu "a single option looks like a fait accompli", từ "fait accompli" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "a single option looks like a fait accompli", what does "fait accompli" (phrase) mean?
options: việc đã rồi, không thể đổi
optionsEn: a done deal, no choice left
items.explanation: fait accompli /ˌfeɪt əˈkɒm.pliː/ (cụm từ): việc đã rồi, không thể đổi. Từ gốc Pháp: "fait accompli" = sự việc đã quyết xong, người khác chỉ còn chấp nhận.
items.explanationEn: fait accompli /ˌfeɪt əˈkɒm.pliː/ (phrase): a done deal, no choice left. From French: a fait accompli is something already decided that others can only accept.

items.question: Trong câu "Influence without authority. Architects rarely manage the builders.", từ "authority" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Influence without authority. Architects rarely manage the builders.", what does "authority" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: authority /ɔːˈθɒr.ə.ti/ (danh từ): quyền hạn chính thức. "Influence without authority" = gây ảnh hưởng dù không có quyền ra lệnh.
items.explanationEn: authority /ɔːˈθɒr.ə.ti/ (noun): formal power to decide. "Influence without authority" means persuading people you cannot give orders to.

items.question: Trong câu "Architects rarely manage the builders.", từ "rarely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Architects rarely manage the builders.", what does "rarely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: rarely /ˈreə.li/ (trạng từ): hiếm khi. "Rarely" = hiếm khi; cùng nhóm tần suất với seldom, occasionally, often.
items.explanationEn: rarely /ˈreə.li/ (adverb): seldom. "Rarely" means seldom; it sits with occasionally and often on the frequency scale.

items.question: Trong câu "When developers push back, listen", từ "push back" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When developers push back, listen", what does "push back" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: push back /pʊʃ ˈbæk/ (cụm từ): phản đối, không đồng ý. "Push back (on X)" = phản đối X; "push back a deadline" lại là dời hạn chót.
items.explanationEn: push back /pʊʃ ˈbæk/ (phrase): to object or resist. "Push back (on X)" means objecting to X; "push back a deadline" means postponing it.

items.question: Trong câu "then settle it with a spike and record the outcome in an ADR", từ "settle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "then settle it with a spike and record the outcome in an ADR", what does "settle" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: settle /ˈset.əl/ (động từ): giải quyết dứt điểm. "Settle a dispute/argument" = giải quyết xong tranh cãi.
items.explanationEn: settle /ˈset.əl/ (verb): to resolve finally. "Settle a dispute or argument" means bringing it to an end.

items.question: Trong câu "Speak in consequences, not technology.", từ "consequence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Speak in consequences, not technology.", what does "consequence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: consequence /ˈkɒn.sɪ.kwəns/ (danh từ): hệ quả, kết quả. "Consequences" = hệ quả; "of little consequence" lại có nghĩa là "ít quan trọng".
items.explanationEn: consequence /ˈkɒn.sɪ.kwəns/ (noun): a result or effect. Consequences are results; "of little consequence" means unimportant.

items.question: Trong câu "Capacity estimates are about orders of magnitude, not precision.", từ "order of magnitude" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Capacity estimates are about orders of magnitude, not precision.", what does "order of magnitude" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: a scale of powers of ten
items.explanation: order of magnitude /ˈɔː.dər əv ˈmæɡ.nɪ.tʃuːd/ (cụm từ): bậc độ lớn (hệ số 10). "Order of magnitude" = bậc gấp 10 lần; "two orders of magnitude" = gấp khoảng 100 lần.
items.explanationEn: order of magnitude /ˈɔː.dər əv ˈmæɡ.nɪ.tʃuːd/ (phrase): a scale of powers of ten. An order of magnitude is a factor of ten; "two orders of magnitude" is about 100 times.

items.question: Trong câu "Capacity estimates are about orders of magnitude, not precision.", từ "precision" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Capacity estimates are about orders of magnitude, not precision.", what does "precision" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: precision /prɪˈsɪʒ.ən/ (danh từ): độ chính xác chi tiết. "Precision" = độ chính xác tới từng chi tiết; tính từ: precise.
items.explanationEn: precision /prɪˈsɪʒ.ən/ (noun): exactness of detail. Precision is exactness down to detail; adjective: precise.

items.question: Trong câu "A short JSON record is ~1 KB, a compressed photo ~1 MB.", từ "compressed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A short JSON record is ~1 KB, a compressed photo ~1 MB.", what does "compressed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: compressed /kəmˈprest/ (tính từ): đã nén. "Compressed file" = tệp đã nén để giảm dung lượng; động từ: compress.
items.explanationEn: compressed /kəmˈprest/ (adjective): reduced in data size. A compressed file has been made smaller in size; verb: compress.

items.question: Trong câu "a network hop inside a data centre costs about as much as several SSD reads", từ "hop" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "a network hop inside a data centre costs about as much as several SSD reads", what does "hop" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: hop /hɒp/ (danh từ): một chặng truyền mạng. "Network hop" = một chặng dữ liệu đi qua giữa hai thiết bị mạng.
items.explanationEn: hop /hɒp/ (noun): one step between network nodes. A network hop is one step data takes between two network devices.

items.question: Trong câu "Components in series (all must work): multiply.", từ "in series" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Components in series (all must work): multiply.", what does "in series" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in series /ɪn ˈsɪə.riːz/ (cụm từ): nối tiếp nhau. "In series" = mắc nối tiếp; trái nghĩa "in parallel" = song song.
items.explanationEn: in series /ɪn ˈsɪə.riːz/ (phrase): one after another. "In series" means connected one after another; the opposite is in parallel.

items.question: Trong câu "This is why a long chain of synchronous calls lowers availability", từ "synchronous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is why a long chain of synchronous calls lowers availability", what does "synchronous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: synchronous /ˈsɪŋ.krə.nəs/ (tính từ): đồng bộ (chờ phản hồi). "Synchronous call" = lời gọi phải chờ kết quả mới làm tiếp; trái nghĩa "asynchronous".
items.explanationEn: synchronous /ˈsɪŋ.krə.nəs/ (adjective): waiting for each reply. A synchronous call waits for a result before continuing; the opposite is asynchronous.

items.question: Trong câu "and redundancy raises it — provided failures really are independent.", từ "redundancy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "and redundancy raises it — provided failures really are independent.", what does "redundancy" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: redundancy /rɪˈdʌn.dən.si/ (danh từ): sự dự phòng. Trong kỹ thuật, "redundancy" = có thành phần dự phòng; trong nhân sự (Anh-Anh) là bị cho thôi việc.
items.explanationEn: redundancy /rɪˈdʌn.dən.si/ (noun): backup duplication. In engineering, redundancy means spare components; in British HR it means losing your job.

items.question: Trong câu "and redundancy raises it — provided failures really are independent.", từ "provided" (liên từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "and redundancy raises it — provided failures really are independent.", what does "provided" (conjunction) mean?
items.explanation: provided /prəˈvaɪ.dɪd/ (liên từ): với điều kiện là. "Provided (that)" = miễn là, với điều kiện; gần nghĩa "as long as".
items.explanationEn: provided /prəˈvaɪ.dɪd/ (conjunction): on condition that. "Provided (that)" means on condition that; similar to "as long as".

items.question: Trong câu "Write the assumptions first, then compute with round numbers:", từ "round number" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Write the assumptions first, then compute with round numbers:", what does "round number" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: round number /raʊnd ˈnʌm.bər/ (cụm từ): số tròn. "Round numbers" = số làm tròn (như 200, 10.000) để tính nhẩm nhanh.
items.explanationEn: round number /raʊnd ˈnʌm.bər/ (phrase): a number rounded off. Round numbers are simplified figures (like 200 or 10,000) for quick mental maths.

items.question: Trong câu "A 50:1 read/write ratio shapes the design: CDN for photos, cache for hot metadata, read replicas.", từ "ratio" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A 50:1 read/write ratio shapes the design: CDN for photos, cache for hot metadata, read replicas.", what does "ratio" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: ratio /ˈreɪ.ʃi.əʊ/ (danh từ): tỷ lệ. "Read/write ratio" = tỷ lệ đọc so với ghi; 50:1 đọc là "fifty to one".
items.explanationEn: ratio /ˈreɪ.ʃi.əʊ/ (noun): a proportion. A read/write ratio compares reads to writes; 50:1 is read "fifty to one".

items.question: Trong câu "say so and propose a load test to measure it", từ "propose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "say so and propose a load test to measure it", what does "propose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: propose /prəˈpəʊz/ (động từ): đề xuất. "Propose a solution" = đưa ra đề xuất; danh từ: proposal.
items.explanationEn: propose /prəˈpəʊz/ (verb): to suggest. "Propose a solution" means putting it forward; noun: proposal.

items.question: Trong câu "off by 1,000× (MB vs GB, per day vs per second) is the mistake interviewers look for", từ "off by" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "off by 1,000× (MB vs GB, per day vs per second) is the mistake interviewers look for", what does "off by" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: off by /ɒf baɪ/ (cụm từ): lệch một khoảng. "Off by X" = sai lệch X so với đúng; lỗi "off-by-one" là lệch một đơn vị.
items.explanationEn: off by /ɒf baɪ/ (phrase): wrong by an amount. "Off by X" means wrong by X; an "off-by-one" error is wrong by one.

items.question: Trong câu "Separate requirements from constraints (fixed) and assumptions (unverified risks).", từ "unverified" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Separate requirements from constraints (fixed) and assumptions (unverified risks).", what does "unverified" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unverified /ʌnˈver.ɪ.faɪd/ (tính từ): chưa được kiểm chứng. "Unverified" = chưa được xác minh; tiền tố "un-" mang nghĩa phủ định.
items.explanationEn: unverified /ʌnˈver.ɪ.faɪd/ (adjective): not yet confirmed. Unverified means not yet checked; the prefix "un-" makes it negative.

items.question: Trong câu "Make quality attributes measurable with scenarios", từ "measurable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Make quality attributes measurable with scenarios", what does "measurable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: measurable /ˈmeʒ.ər.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): đo lường được. "Measurable goal" = mục tiêu đo được bằng số; "measurable" cũng có nghĩa "đáng kể".
items.explanationEn: measurable /ˈmeʒ.ər.ə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be measured. A measurable goal can be expressed in numbers; measurable can also mean noticeable.

items.question: Trong câu "A Solutions Architect bridges business goals and technical delivery", từ "bridge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A Solutions Architect bridges business goals and technical delivery", what does "bridge" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: bridge /brɪdʒ/ (động từ): kết nối, làm cầu nối. "Bridge the gap between A and B" = thu hẹp khoảng cách, kết nối A với B.
items.explanationEn: bridge /brɪdʒ/ (verb): to connect two sides. "Bridge the gap between A and B" means connecting A and B.

items.question: Trong câu "is judged by whether the solution is built, runs and meets its goals", từ "judge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "is judged by whether the solution is built, runs and meets its goals", what does "judge" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: judge /dʒʌdʒ/ (động từ): đánh giá. "Be judged by X" = được đánh giá dựa trên X.
items.explanationEn: judge /dʒʌdʒ/ (verb): to evaluate. "Be judged by X" means being evaluated on the basis of X.

items.question: Trong câu "Back-of-the-envelope estimates in orders of magnitude tell you early whether a design is in the right league for load, storage and cost.", từ "back-of-the-envelope" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Back-of-the-envelope estimates in orders of magnitude tell you early whether a design is in the right league for load, storage and cost.", what does "back-of-the-envelope" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: back-of-the-envelope /ˌbæk əv ði ˈen.və.ləʊp/ (tính từ): tính nhẩm sơ bộ. "Back-of-the-envelope calculation" = phép tính nhanh, gần đúng (như ghi vội sau phong bì).
items.explanationEn: back-of-the-envelope /ˌbæk əv ði ˈen.və.ləʊp/ (adjective): rough and quick. A back-of-the-envelope calculation is a quick rough estimate, as if scribbled on an envelope.

items.question: Trong câu "whether a design is in the right league for load, storage and cost", từ "league" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "whether a design is in the right league for load, storage and cost", what does "league" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: league /liːɡ/ (danh từ): tầm cỡ, đẳng cấp. "In the right league" = đúng tầm cỡ; "out of someone's league" = vượt quá tầm.
items.explanationEn: league /liːɡ/ (noun): a level of quality. "In the right league" means at the right level; "out of your league" means beyond your level.
